evidence: Figures 4(a) and 4(b) show the refractive indices obtained using spectroscopic ellipsometry at a wavelength of 633 nm for varying composition of the mixed oxide films deposited using thermal and plasma ALD. The refractive index plots exhibit a decreasing trend with an increase in Si content of the Si xTi1−xO2 films, from ∼2.3 for TiO 2 (x = 0) up to ∼1.5 for SiO 2 (x = 1).
